name: Czechia

train.sum: Praha hlavni nadrazi is the main station. Trains link Prague with Brno, Vienna, Berlin and Budapest.
train.sched: Suburban trains run from early morning to late evening.
tickets: Prague public transport tickets are valid on trains within Prague
Regiojet and Leo Express: private operators
Book Prague to Brno early for the cheapest fares
train.tip: Regiojet tickets include a seat reservation. Book early for low fares.
buy: CD ticket counters at Praha hlavni nadrazi and other stations. Cash and cards accepted.
PID Litacka app: tickets for trains inside Prague and the region. Activate at least 1 minute before the train comes.
PID Info desk in CD Centrum, one floor below the main station hall, about 08:00 to 18:30.
On board: the conductor sells tickets. If you board at a station with an open ticket office, you pay a surcharge.
For Prague city trips, ask the conductor for a PID ticket. SMS tickets are not valid on trains.

tram.sum: Prague has 26 day tram lines and 3 metro lines (A, B, C). Tram 22 passes many sights.
tram.sched: Metro about 05:00 to 00:00. Night trams run about 00:00 to 05:00.
tram.tip: Validate paper tickets in the yellow machine. The PID Litacka app is the cheapest way to buy. SMS tickets cost more.
buy: On board: touchscreen terminal at the middle door sells 30-minute, 90-minute and 24-hour tickets. Contactless card only, no stamping needed.
PID Litacka app: all tickets, and the cheapest price.
Ticket machines at stops and metro stations. Button machines take coins only. Touchscreen machines take coins and contactless cards.
Metro touchscreen terminals: contactless card only. The ticket is already valid.
Information centres, shops and newsstands sell paper tickets. Stamp them once in the yellow machine.
SMS ticket: costs more, for example 55 CZK for 90 minutes.

bus.sum: PID buses connect the suburbs. Long-distance coaches use Florenc station.
bus.sched: Day buses about 05:00 to 00:00. Night buses on 900 series.
tickets: Same tickets as tram and metro
Airport trolleybus 59 and bus 100: normal Prague ticket
Prague Visitor Pass: sights and transport
bus.tip: A normal Prague ticket covers the airport. The 90-minute ticket is best for the trip.
buy: On city buses and trolleybuses: touchscreen terminal at the second door. Contactless card only, 30-minute, 90-minute or 24-hour tickets.
PID Litacka app, ticket machines, information centres and newsstands: same tickets as for trams.
Suburban and regional buses: board at the front and buy from the driver. Coins, notes up to 200 CZK or contactless card.
Paper tickets from machines and shops must be stamped once when you board.

airport.sum: Vaclav Havel Airport Prague (PRG) is northwest of the centre, about 20 km by road. There is no train to the airport.
airport.sched: Trolleybus 59 takes about 15 minutes to Nadrazi Veleslavin (metro A). Bus 100 goes to Zlicin (metro B).
tickets: Trolleybus 59 + metro: 50 CZK (46 CZK in app)
AE Airport Express to the main station: 200 CZK
Official airport taxi: Uber Airport, fixed price in the app
airport.tip: Use the official Uber Airport service or a ride-hailing app. Taxi meters have no price cap since October 2026.
buy: Ticket machines in both arrival halls and at the bus stops. Most take contactless cards.
DPP counters: Terminal 1 arrival hall about 07:00 to 21:00, Terminal 2 about 09:00 to 21:00.
PID Litacka app: 90-minute ticket for buses 59 and 100 plus metro, 46 CZK. SMS ticket 55 CZK.
On board buses 59 and 100: contactless card terminal. The airport asks you to buy before boarding if you can.
AE Airport Express to the main station: own fare of 200 CZK. 24-hour and 72-hour passes are not valid.
No train to the airport.

metro.note: Three metro lines: A (green), B (yellow) and C (red). Trams cover the rest of the centre.
lines: Line A (green) passes Mustek and Malostranska for the castle
Line C (red) links the main station and Vysehrad
Mustek links A and B, Muzeum links A and C, Florenc links B and C

tips: Validate paper tickets in the yellow machine at the station entrance.
A normal Prague ticket covers the airport. Only the AE Airport Express needs its own ticket.
Tram 22 passes many main sights, so it works as a cheap tour.
The fine without a valid ticket is 1,500 CZK if you pay on the spot or within 15 days, and 2,000 CZK after that.
